sql: CREATE TABLE edge_nullable_p(id INT PRIMARY KEY,a INT,b INT,UNIQUE(a,b))
CREATE TABLE edge_nullable_c(id INT PRIMARY KEY,a INT,b INT,FOREIGN KEY(a,b) REFERENCES edge_nullable_p(a,b) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE)
UPDATE edge_nullable_p SET a=3 WHERE id=1
SELECT id,a,b FROM edge_nullable_c ORDER BY id
